message: A token count on a page comes from a live session, or from `vectoralis budget`, which was measured against one. Four characters to a token read a third too low here.
instead: run `vectoralis budget`, or read the first request of a session with the plugins and without.

payloads.name: catches the rule of thumb on a guide page
payloads.text: It counts characters and divides by four, and says it is an estimate.

payloads.name: passes the measured rate
payloads.text: It counts characters and divides by 2.7, and says it is an estimate.

payloads.name: passes the same words outside the guide
payloads.text: It counted characters and divided by four.
